list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Fed from kube-state-metrics, never from process_start_time_seconds: oracle is minReplicaCount 0, so a process-lifecycle metric leaves this variable — and every panel, including the backlog and KEDA rows that survive the sleeping pod — empty in the connector's normal state.

list.name: pod
list.label: Pod
list.description: allValue is .+ and not .*: every series is scraped twice in dev (PodMonitor plus the kubernetes-services catch-all) and only the PodMonitor copy carries a pod label. In PromQL .* also matches the absent label, which doubles every additive aggregation while leaving percentiles and _sum/_count ratios correct.

options.content:
**Totals add up every scan in the time range.** Two scans of a 13-owner database read 26 owners. To count what the database holds, narrow the range to one scan.

**Bars and stats say _how many_. The line charts beside them say _when_.** A scan shorter than ~30 seconds can be invisible on a line chart and still be fully counted in the bars.

**What this board cannot tell you:** anything per datasource or per owner (Oracle's metrics carry neither label — the DLQ messages do name the owner), and how many PDBs were scanned (with a credential to a single PDB, everything here is inside that one PDB).

Hover the ⓘ on any panel for what it counts, what is normal, and where to look next.

panels.title: Scan Duration (window, ±15 s)
panels.description:
**How long the scan took, end to end**: from the moment its owners were queued to the last table read. With several scans in the range it spans all of them, idle gaps included.

**Normal:** seconds to minutes. Precise to about ±15 s, because it is measured from samples taken every 10–30 s — a scan of a few seconds can read 0 s or 15 s. Owners run in parallel, so a small database really does finish in seconds (the local test database: about 5 s).

**Next:** 'Fan-out over time' in the Scanner row shows the same span as a shape.

targets.expr: max_over_time(timestamp(sum(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)) > 0)[$__range:15s]) - min_over_time(timestamp(sum(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)) > 0)[$__range:15s])

panels.title: Objects Scanned (total)
panels.description:
**Tables and views whose columns were read successfully.**

**Normal:** the tables + views of every scanned owner, once per scan in the range.

**Next:** 'Objects Failed' beside it; the funnel splits them by outcome.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Columns Found (total)
panels.description:
**Columns read across all scanned tables and views.** Each one becomes a document.

**Normal:** roughly objects × average width (see 'Columns per Object' on the Pipeline board).

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Documents Sent (total)
panels.description:
**Documents handed on for indexing: one per column, plus one per table or view.** It counts documents sent, not distinct tables — the same table scanned twice is sent twice.

**Normal:** exactly Columns Found + Objects Scanned.

**Next:** 'Documents (window)' in the funnel, to see the two kinds apart.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Objects Failed (total)
panels.description:
**Tables or views whose columns could not be read.**

**Normal:** 0. Temporary failures are retried by rescanning the whole owner; permanent ones (permissions, broken definitions) are skipped and reported.

**Next:** the Scan Completeness row splits temporary from permanent.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Content Fetches (total)
panels.description:
**Column samples requested from the content side**, any outcome. Content runs on its own pods, triggered separately from scans.

**Normal:** whatever the downstream classifier asked for; 0 when nothing requested samples.

**Next:** the Content row.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Owners Published
panels.description:
**Owners put on the queue to be scanned** — the start of the funnel.

**Normal:** the number of non-system schemas per scan.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Owner Fork Attempts
panels.description:
**Attempts to scan an owner — not owners.** An owner that fails temporarily is retried, up to 5 times, and every try counts here.

**Normal:** equal to Owners Published. Well above it means owners are failing and being retried.

**Next:** 'NATS — Redelivered' and 'Owners Lost (DLQ)'.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Owners Lost (DLQ)
panels.description:
**Owners that failed all 5 attempts and were given up on.** Each one is a whole schema that was not indexed — while its scan still reports success.

**Normal:** 0. The board cannot name them; each message in the dead-letter queue does: `nats stream get DLQ_CONSUME_ORACLE <seq>` shows the owner and the last error.

**Next:** the Dead Letter Queue row at the bottom.

panels.title: Owners Completed
panels.description:
**Owners published minus owners lost.** Nothing counts a successful owner directly, so this is a subtraction.

**Normal:** equal to Owners Published once the scan has finished. While it is still running it also includes owners not done yet.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_owners_published_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0)) - ((max_over_time(max(nats_stream_last_seq{stream_name="DLQ_CONSUME_ORACLE"})[$__range:30s]) - min_over_time(max(nats_stream_last_seq{stream_name="DLQ_CONSUME_ORACLE"})[$__range:30s])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Empty Owners
panels.description:
**Owners that have no tables or views** (or none the scan account is allowed to see).

**Normal:** some — service accounts often own nothing. A sudden jump on a database that used to have data usually means the scan account lost a permission.

**Next:** 'Scans Without DBA Access' in Scan Completeness.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Objects Listed
panels.description:
**Tables and views found in the owners: read + failed.**

**Normal:** equal to Objects Scanned when nothing failed. Retries list the same table again, so under retries it counts more than exist.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) + ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Table Docs per Object
panels.description:
**Does every table get its own document?** Each scanned table or view should produce exactly one table document.

**Normal:** 100%. Lower means table documents stopped going out while column documents kept flowing — the scan still looks green, and this is the only place it shows.

**Next:** 'Documents (window)' below.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0)

panels.title: Column Docs per Column
panels.description:
**Does every column get its own document?**

**Normal:** 100%. Lower means column documents failed to go out.

**Next:** 'Documents (window)' below.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0)

panels.title: Objects by Outcome (window)
panels.description:
**What happened to every table and view found.** Scanned = columns read. Failed — transient = a temporary problem (connection, timeout); the owner is retried. Failed — permanent = permissions or a broken definition; retrying will not help. Empty table = it disappeared or lost permissions between listing and reading (a subset of scanned).

**Normal:** all green. Orange needs a permission or schema fix; red needs a look at the database's health.

**Next:** the line chart beside it shows when.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="true"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="true"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="true"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="false"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="false"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="false"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="table"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="table"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="table"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Objects by Outcome (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When tables were scanned or failed**, same colours as the bars beside it.

**Normal:** a green bump per scan. A scan shorter than ~30 seconds may not show here at all — the bars still count it.

**Next:** the bars beside it for how many.

panels.title: Documents (window)
panels.description:
**Documents handed on for indexing, by kind.** Table documents and column documents go to two different indexes in two separate batches, so one can stop while the other keeps working.

**Normal:** table docs = objects scanned, column docs = columns found, failures 0. A failed document never reached the message queue.

**Next:** the line chart beside it shows when.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_item_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_item_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_item_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="table"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_item_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_item_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_item_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", kind="column"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Documents by kind (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When documents went out**, by kind.

**Normal:** both kinds rise and fall together. One flat while the other moves means a whole index stopped receiving.

panels.title: NATS — Scanner Backlog
panels.description:
**Work waiting in the queue** (stream JE_ORACLE): scan requests and owners not picked up yet. This is 'how far behind is it?', and it is readable even while the connector is asleep.

**Normal:** 0 between scans. Growing with no pods running means the connector is not waking up.

panels.title: NATS — In Flight (unacked)
panels.description:
**Work handed to a pod and not finished yet.**

**Normal:** a few while a scan runs, 0 otherwise. Stuck high while nothing is being scanned means a pod is hung.

panels.title: NATS — Redelivered
panels.description:
**Work being retried after a failure.** An owner is retried up to 5 times before going to the dead-letter queue.

**Normal:** 0. A connector failing and retrying in a loop shows up here and nowhere else.

**Next:** 'Objects by Outcome' for what is failing.

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description:
**Scanner pods running now**, as the autoscaler reports them.

**Normal:** 0 between scans, 1–3 during one.

panels.title: Max Replicas
panels.description:
**The most scanner pods the autoscaler may start** (chart setting autoscaling.maxReplicas, 3 by default).

**Normal:** read it against Replicas: at the ceiling with a growing backlog means the scanner cannot go faster.

panels.title: NATS — Backlog Slope (2m)
panels.description:
**How fast the backlog is growing**, in messages per second. This is exactly what one of the autoscaler's rules looks at.

**Normal:** 0. Above 0.5 the autoscaler adds pods.

panels.title: NATS — Scanner Consumer Backlog
panels.description:
**The queue over time.** Pending = waiting, ack pending = being worked on, redelivered = being retried. Each message is a scan request or a whole owner, so 3 pending can be three entire schemas.

**Normal:** spikes at the start of a scan that drain to 0.

panels.title: KEDA — Replicas: current vs desired vs max
panels.description:
**Pods running, pods wanted, and the ceiling.**

**Normal:** pods stay up ~15 minutes after the work ends (cooldown 900s, scale-down window 600s). 'It scaled ten minutes ago and is still the same' is configuration, not a bug.

panels.title: Pods Up
panels.description:
**Scanner pods answering right now.**

**Normal:** 0 when idle — the scanner scales to zero between scans. That is not an outage.

panels.title: Restarts (1h)
panels.description:
**Scanner container restarts in the last hour.**

**Normal:** 0.

panels.title: Objects Scanned (window)
panels.description:
**Same number as in Totals**, repeated so this row reads on its own.

**Normal:** see Totals.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Objects Failed (window)
panels.description:
**Tables or views that could not be read**, temporary + permanent.

**Normal:** 0.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Documents Sent (window)
panels.description:
**Table + column documents handed on.**

**Normal:** Columns Found + Objects Scanned.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Owner Duration — mean / p95
panels.description:
**How long scanning one owner takes.** The mean is the typical owner — multiply it by the number of owners to estimate a bigger database. The p95 is how long the slowest 5% of owners took.

**Normal:** mean and p95 close together means owners are similar in size. A p95 several times the mean means a few owners are much bigger than the rest.

**Next:** the 'Owner Duration — distribution' heatmap on the Pipeline board shows them individually.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_schema_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])))

panels.title: Scan Fan-out — mean
panels.description:
**Only the first step of a scan: listing the owners and queuing them.** It is NOT how long the whole scan took — the owners are scanned afterwards, possibly on other pods.

**Normal:** well under a second. There is no 'whole scan' timer.

**Next:** 'Fan-out over time' below: from the first to the last movement of 'objects scanned' is the scan's real duration.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

panels.title: Scanner Throughput (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**How fast the scanner is working**, while it works.

**Normal:** only meaningful during a long scan; a short one may read 0 here and still be fully counted in the stats above.

panels.title: Fan-out over time (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When the scan ran.** The span from the first to the last movement of 'objects scanned' is the closest thing to how long the whole scan took — nothing measures it directly.

**Normal:** fork attempts on top of owners published. Fork attempts above it means owners are being retried.

panels.title: Owner Duration — p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description:
**Owner scan time over time**, as percentiles.

**Normal:** only readable under sustained load. For a single scan use the mean / p95 stat above.

panels.title: Work In Flight
panels.description:
**How much the pod is working on at once**: scan requests, owners and tables. Highest value seen in each minute.

**Normal:** owners at most NATS_WORKERS (10) per pod, tables at most ORACLE_POOL_WORKERS (10). Values are sampled every ~10-30s, so very short bursts can be missed.

panels.title: KEDA — ack-capacity signal vs threshold
panels.description:
**One of the autoscaler's rules: work in progress against its threshold** (red line, 1000). Crossing it asks for another pod.

**Normal:** far below the line.

panels.title: KEDA — trend-based signal vs threshold
panels.description:
**Another autoscaler rule: is the queue growing?** Above the red line (0.5 messages/s) it adds pods.

**Normal:** 0. A third rule wakes the scanner from zero on the first queued message — that is the backlog panel above.

panels.title: Connections Open (peak) — ceiling 20 per job
panels.description:
**Most connections to Oracle this pod held at the same time.** Each scan opens its own set of up to 20 connections (NATS_WORKERS + ORACLE_POOL_WORKERS, 10 + 10), and keeps idle ones for ~2.5 minutes after it ends.

**Normal:** at most 20 × the number of scans running at once. The real limit is the database's own session limit, which we do not control: past it Oracle refuses connections (ORA-12516), tables fail as 'transient' and owners end up in the dead-letter queue. Measured locally: 30 scans at once → 114 connections → 123 owners lost.

**Next:** 'Job Contexts Active' beside it is the multiplier.

panels.title: Job Contexts Active
panels.description:
**Scans this pod is keeping in memory** — not connections. Each one keeps its own connections: one set, or one more per PDB on a multi-PDB database. They are only dropped on errors or when the pod stops, so this grows by one per scan.

**Normal:** the number of scans this pod has run since it started. Connections ≈ this × (1 + PDBs) × up to 20.

**Next:** 'Connections Open (peak)' beside it.

panels.title: Connections In Use (peak)
panels.description:
**Most connections actually running a query at the same time.**

**Normal:** below 20. Sampled every ~10-30s, so a small scan can read 0 here and still have used connections.

panels.title: Query p95 (window)
panels.description:
**How slow the slowest 5% of the scanner's SQL queries were**, all kinds together.

**Normal:** under a second or two on a healthy database.

**Next:** 'Query Time by Type' below, and the Pipeline board for each kind's percentiles.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])))

panels.title: Connection Errors (window)
panels.description:
**Failures setting up a scan's connection to Oracle**: fetching the credentials, connecting, or checking permissions.

**Normal:** 0. NOT where an overloaded database shows up: a connection refused in the middle of a scan counts as a temporary table failure instead.

**Next:** 'Objects by Outcome' and 'Connections Open (peak)'.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_connection_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_connection_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_connection_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Publish Retries (window)
panels.description:
**Times queuing an owner failed and had to be retried.** Retries stop after 10 minutes (ORACLE_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT) and the whole scan is retried.

**Normal:** 0. This is the early warning before that happens.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_publish_retries_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_publish_retries_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_publish_retries_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Connection Pool — open / in use / idle
panels.description:
**Connections to Oracle over time**, all of this pod's scans together. The red line is one scan's ceiling (20).

**Normal:** 'open' above the line just means several scans are alive — that sum is what the database has to serve. 'in use' pinned at the line while tables are in flight means the connections, not the connector, are the bottleneck.

panels.title: Query Time by Type (window)
panels.description:
**Where the scanner spent its database time**: total seconds per kind of query. list_tables runs once per owner, query_columns once per table, the rest (sizes, tablespaces, modifications) once per owner for extended metadata.

**Normal:** list_tables or query_columns on top. A metadata query near the top means extended metadata is costing as much as the scan itself.

**Next:** the Pipeline board has each kind's percentiles and counts.

targets.expr: sum by (query_type) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0

panels.title: Connection Errors by stage (window)
panels.description:
**Which setup step failed.** credential_fetch = getting the password from the credential manager. pool_open = connecting to Oracle (unreachable, wrong password, wrong service name). scope_probe = checking which catalog views the account can read.

**Normal:** empty.

targets.expr: ((sum by (stage) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_connection_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_connection_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_connection_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Scans Without DBA Access (window)
panels.description:
**Scans that could only see part of the database.** The scan account should have the SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE role to read the full catalog (the DBA_* views). Without it the scan quietly switches to the ALL_* views, which only show what the account was explicitly granted: every owner is still listed, most come back empty, nothing errors, and the scan finishes green.

**Normal:** 0. Anything else: grant SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE to the scan account.

**Next:** 'Catalog Access' just below.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="fallback"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="fallback"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="fallback"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: PDBs Skipped (window)
panels.description:
**Whole pluggable databases left out of a scan.** Only happens when the credential points at the container root and the scan walks every PDB.

**Normal:** 0. Each one is an entire database missing from a green scan.

**Next:** the reasons below.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_pdbs_skipped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_pdbs_skipped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_pdbs_skipped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Empty Outcomes (window)
panels.description:
**Things that were scanned and turned out to be empty**: whole scans, PDBs, owners or tables.

**Normal:** a few empty owners are normal. A jump on a database that used to have data points at a missing permission.

**Next:** the breakdown by level below.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Permanent Object Errors (window)
panels.description:
**Tables or views that failed for a reason retries cannot fix**: permissions or a broken definition. They are skipped and reported; the rest of the owner continues.

**Normal:** 0.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="false"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="false"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", transient="false"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Extended Metadata Degraded (window)
panels.description:
**Optional table details that could not be collected**: tablespaces, sizes, last-used and last-modified dates. They are optional, so a table without them looks the same as a table that simply has none — only this panel tells them apart.

**Normal:** 0, or a steady 1 per scan if the database has HEAT_MAP off (a database setting, not a fault).

**Next:** the table below says which detail and why.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_extended_metadata_degradations_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_extended_metadata_degradations_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_extended_metadata_degradations_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Error Reports Dropped (window)
panels.description:
**Errors the connector found but could not report.** When a table fails, the connector adds it to the scan's error list — what the UI shows. This counts the ones that never got there.

**Normal:** 0. Anything else means the scan's error list in the UI is incomplete: the failures happened, nobody will see them.

**Next:** the breakdown by reason below.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_error_reporter_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_error_reporter_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_error_reporter_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Catalog Access (window)
panels.description:
**How much of the database each scan could see**, one count per scan. Full catalog = everything. ALL views by config = limited on purpose (ORACLE_CATALOG_SCOPE=all). ALL views, role missing = it should have seen everything but the account lacks SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE — it saw only what it was explicitly granted.

**Normal:** all green.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="dba", reason="configured"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="dba", reason="configured"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="dba", reason="configured"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="configured"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="configured"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="configured"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="fallback"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="fallback"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_catalog_scope_resolutions_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="all", reason="fallback"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Empty Outcomes by level (window)
panels.description:
**At which level something came back empty.** Scan = no owners at all. PDB = a database with no owners. Owner = an owner with no tables. Table = a table that vanished between being listed and being read.

**Normal:** only empty owners. Orange levels (scan, PDB) do not happen on a healthy database.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="scan"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="scan"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="scan"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="pdb"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="pdb"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="pdb"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="owner"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="table"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="table"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_empty_scan_outcomes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", scope="table"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: PDBs Skipped by reason (window)
panels.description:
**Why a PDB was left out.** not_listed = closed or dropped mid-scan. credential = the account cannot log in there. listing_denied = it can log in but cannot list. identity_mismatch = its service name leads to another database. no_pdb = an internal bug.

**Normal:** empty.

targets.expr: ((sum by (reason) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_pdbs_skipped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_pdbs_skipped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_pdbs_skipped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Error Reports Dropped by reason (window)
panels.description:
**Why error reports were lost.** buffer_full = errors came in faster than they could be sent. after_close / flush_timeout = they arrived after the owner had already finished (flush_timeout is the worst: they were abandoned). no_api = the reporter was never connected.

**Normal:** empty.

targets.expr: ((sum by (reason) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_error_reporter_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_error_reporter_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_error_reporter_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Extended Metadata Degradations (window)
panels.description:
**Which optional detail was not collected, and why.** parameter_off = HEAT_MAP is off in the database, so last-used dates do not exist (a setting, not a fault). scope_all = the scan had no DBA access, so none of the details were collected. not_readable = missing grant. query_failed / probe_failed = the query errored. circuit_open = it failed for enough owners that the scan stopped trying.

**Normal:** empty, or only heat_map / parameter_off.

targets.expr: sum by (capability, reason) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_scanner_extended_metadata_degradations_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_scanner_extended_metadata_degradations_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_scanner_extended_metadata_degradations_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0

panels.title: Extended Metadata Retries by source (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**Optional-detail queries that failed once and worked on retry.** They never count as degraded, so this is the only trace.

**Normal:** empty. A rising line is the warning that the database is getting slow enough for the next retry to fail too.

panels.title: Pods Up
panels.description:
**Content pods answering right now.**

**Normal:** 0 when idle — content also scales to zero.

panels.title: Restarts (1h)
panels.description:
**Content container restarts in the last hour.**

**Normal:** 0.

panels.title: Fetches (window)
panels.description:
**Column samples requested**, any outcome.

**Normal:** whatever was asked for.

**Next:** 'Content Fetches by Outcome' below.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Content Fetch — mean / p95
panels.description:
**How long one sample takes**, end to end. Mean = the typical one; multiply by the number of columns to estimate a bigger job. p95 = the slowest 5%.

**Normal:** well under a second. Sampling cost grows with the size of the TABLE, so every column of a big table is slow.

**Next:** the Pipeline board for the streaming part on its own.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])))

panels.title: Errors (window)
panels.description:
**Samples that did not succeed**, for any reason.

**Normal:** 0, but not every error is a problem — see the colours in the breakdown.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome!="success"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome!="success"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome!="success"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: NATS — Fetch Backlog
panels.description:
**Bulk sample requests waiting** (the classifier's queue).

**Normal:** 0 between jobs.

panels.title: NATS — Interactive Backlog
panels.description:
**'See content' requests waiting** — a person in the UI is waiting on each of these.

**Normal:** 0 almost always. Anything else means someone is staring at a spinner.

panels.title: Content Fetches by Outcome (window)
panels.description:
**What happened to every sample request.** Green = fine. Yellow = expected (the column or table no longer exists, or the sample is over the size limit). Orange = configuration (bad request, credential, permission). Red = needs a look.

**Normal:** mostly green. Note: read_error also includes columns whose type cannot be sampled at all (LONG, LONG RAW, BFILE, XMLTYPE) — those are expected, not a database failure.

**Next:** 'Unsupported Types' in Sample Quality tells how many of the read_errors are that.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0

panels.title: Content Fetches by Outcome (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When samples happened and how they ended**, same colours as the bars beside it.

**Normal:** bursts when a classification job runs.

panels.title: Content — In Flight & Connections
panels.description:
**How busy the content pods are.**

**Normal:** at most 4 samples at once per pod (CONTENT_FETCH_WORKERS) and 10 connections (ORACLE_POOL_WORKERS).

panels.title: NATS — Content Consumer Backlog
panels.description:
**Both content queues over time**: bulk (classifier) and interactive (a person waiting in the UI).

**Normal:** spikes that drain to 0. Each request is retried at most 3 times.

panels.title: KEDA — Content Replicas: current vs desired vs max
panels.description:
**Content pods running, wanted, and the ceiling** (10 by default, versus 3 for the scanner).

**Normal:** 0 when idle.

panels.title: KEDA — Content Trigger Signals
panels.description:
**What the content autoscaler looks at.** The interactive rule exists so a single 'See content' request wakes the pods even when nothing else is queued.

**Normal:** far below the thresholds in the legend.

panels.title: Samples Recovered (window)
panels.description:
**Random samples that came back empty although the column has data**, rescued by reading the whole column instead.

**Normal:** common on small tables — 10% of a 3-row table is usually no rows. On big tables it means the sample percentage (ORACLE_CONTENT_SAMPLE_PERCENT) is too low for how sparse the data is.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="recovered"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="recovered"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="recovered"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Empty Columns (window)
panels.description:
**Columns with nothing to sample**: every value is NULL, or every value is an empty LOB.

**Normal:** some. Expected, not a failure.

**Next:** the breakdown below.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome=~"empty|unrendered"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome=~"empty|unrendered"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_verify_empty_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome=~"empty|unrendered"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.description:
**How many tries a sample needs on average**, from 1 to 4 (4 = it had to read the whole column).

**Normal:** close to 1. Drifting up means samples keep coming back too small and are being redrawn.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / clamp_min(sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_sample_attempts_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])), 1)

panels.title: Values Truncated (window)
panels.description:
**Sampled values longer than 4000 characters, cut to that length** (ORACLE_CONTENT_MAX_VALUE_CHARS). The classifier only saw the beginning of these.

**Normal:** 0 unless there are long text or CLOB columns. Sensitive data past character 4000 is not seen.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_values_truncated_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_values_truncated_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_values_truncated_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Unsupported Types (window)
panels.description:
**Columns whose type cannot be sampled at all** (LONG, LONG RAW, BFILE, XMLTYPE, object types). They are reported as read_error.

**Normal:** expected on legacy schemas; not a fault.

**Next:** the breakdown by type below.

panels.title: Samples Cut by Size Limit (window)
panels.description:
**Samples that stopped early because they reached the size limit** (ORACLE_CONTENT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES, 100 MB). The sample is still valid — it just has fewer rows.

**Normal:** 0.

panels.title: Crashes While Reading Rows (window)
panels.description:
**Times the code reading rows from Oracle crashed and recovered.** The request shows up as read_error, but the cause was a bug in the connector, not the database.

**Normal:** 0. Anything else is a connector bug to report.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(oracle_content_producer_panics_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) - last_over_time(oracle_content_producer_panics_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(oracle_content_producer_panics_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Empty Samples by kind (window)
panels.description:
**Why a sample came back with no rows.** empty = the column really is all NULL. unrendered = it has values, but every one is empty (e.g. EMPTY_CLOB()); an empty sample was uploaded. recovered = the random sample missed data that exists, and reading the whole column found it.

**Normal:** yellow is expected; orange is fine on small tables and a tuning hint on big ones.

**Normal:** LONG and LONG RAW on old schemas; anything else is worth a look.

panels.title: Sample Size — rows and KiB per sample (mean, 5m)
panels.description:
**How big the successful samples were**, on average.

**Normal:** between 100 and 1000 rows (ORACLE_CONTENT_SAMPLE_MIN_ROWS / MAX_ROWS); fewer on small tables.

panels.title: DLQ Depth
panels.description:
**Scan work that was given up on and is sitting in the dead-letter queue now.** Each message is a scan request or a whole owner that failed 5 times — a whole schema not indexed while the scan reported success.

**Normal:** 0. To see which owners: each message names the owner and the last error — `nats stream get DLQ_CONSUME_ORACLE <seq>`.

**Next:** 'Owners Lost (DLQ)' in the funnel counts the ones added in the selected range.

panels.title: DLQ Depth over time
panels.description:
**When work started landing in the dead-letter queue.**

**Normal:** flat at 0. A step up marks the moment a scan started losing owners.
